name: empfehlungsbund-arbeitgeber
description: Job ads, employer profile and statistics for Empfehlungsbund employers (login.empfehlungsbund.de).

interface.longDescription:
Recruiting tool for employers in the Empfehlungsbund network (German job boards such as empfehlungsbund.de, ITsax.de and faire-karriere.de). Companies connect their own employer account at login.empfehlungsbund.de via OAuth and let the agent maintain their job ads and employer profile: create job ad drafts, update jobs, company description, benefits, locations and contact persons, check import problems of job feeds, and read click and application statistics per month or job.

New jobs are always created as invisible drafts; publishing requires explicit confirmation. Applicant data (applications, CVs, applicant contact details) is never available through this plugin. Access is limited to the connected user's roles and must be enabled for the company by Empfehlungsbund (pludoni GmbH).
defaultPrompt: Was gibt es Neues in unserem Empfehlungsbund-Account?
Wie viele Klicks hatten unsere Stellen letzten Monat?

positive.prompt: What's new in my Empfehlungsbund account?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists errors and warnings on the account first, then news and upcoming events.

positive.prompt: Which job ads do we currently maintain and which of them are published?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the company's managed job ads with title, job number and visibility.

positive.prompt: Create a job ad draft for a Senior Ruby Developer (m/w/d) at our main location, full remote possible.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an invisible draft with the given title and location and asks before publishing it.

positive.prompt: How many clicks and applications did our job ads get last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports monthly clicks and application counts as totals, without any applicant details.

positive.prompt: Add 'Flexible working hours' to our company description.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current description, appends the sentence and saves the profile.

negative.prompt: Show me the CVs and email addresses of the applicants for our developer job.
Publish all our job drafts right now, don't ask me.
Show me the job ads and statistics of our competitor ACME GmbH.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: account briefing, company profile, contact persons, locations, job ads and statistics for Empfehlungsbund employers.

de-DE.subtitle: Stellen & Firmenprofil pflegen
de-DE.description:
Recruiting-Werkzeug für Arbeitgeber im Empfehlungsbund-Netzwerk (Jobbörsen wie empfehlungsbund.de, ITsax.de und faire-karriere.de). Firmen verbinden ihren Arbeitgeber-Account unter login.empfehlungsbund.de per OAuth und lassen den Agenten Stellenanzeigen und Firmenprofil pflegen: Stellenentwürfe anlegen, Stellen, Firmenbeschreibung, Benefits, Standorte und Ansprechpartner ändern, Importprobleme von Stellenfeeds prüfen sowie Klick- und Bewerbungszahlen pro Monat oder Stelle abrufen.

Neue Stellen entstehen immer als unsichtbarer Entwurf, Veröffentlichen nur nach ausdrücklicher Bestätigung. Bewerberdaten (Bewerbungen, Lebensläufe, Kontaktdaten) sind über das Plugin nie zugänglich. Der Zugriff richtet sich nach den Rollen des verbundenen Nutzers und wird pro Firma von Empfehlungsbund (pludoni GmbH) freigeschaltet.
